Find a local expert in three steps

Searching for “best services near me” returns thousands of results. ThreeBestRated returns three, and each one has been checked against ten areas of the inspection, including reputation, history, complaints, ratings, proximity and more.

  • Reputation
  • History

  1. 1

    Pick what you need

    Choose from more than 200 categories, from doctors and lawyers to restaurants and home services. Search by voice if your hands are full.

  2. 2

    Confirm your city

    The app detects your city and state with GPS, or you can type one of 200+ cities across eight countries.

  3. 3

    Choose from three

    You get the top three verified businesses, with real customer reviews, so the decision takes minutes instead of an evening.

Why people choose the ThreeBestRated app

  • Three results, never thirty

    No endless scrolling and no questionable listings. Each search ends with the top three providers in your area.

  • A 50-point inspection

    Every business is evaluated on reputation, reviews, service quality and business standards before it earns a place.

  • Handpicked by trained analysts

    People, not an algorithm alone, select each business. Listings are reviewed regularly so the information stays accurate.

  • Honest customer reviews

    Read positive and negative feedback side by side, so you can choose with your eyes open.

  • 500,000+ verified businesses

    One app covers the major cities in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, India, Singapore, Germany and France.

  • Free and ad-free

    The app is free to use, with no hidden promotions. The inspection result decides who is listed.

  • In your language

    Use the app in English, German, French or Hindi.

  • Transparent and private

    ThreeBestRated operates with full transparency, strong data protection and strict compliance with advertising laws.

Questions about the ThreeBestRated app

Yes. The app is free to download and free to use on both Android and iPhone. It does not carry hidden promotions.

It shows you the top three local businesses and professionals in your city, such as doctors, lawyers and restaurants, instead of a long list of results. It has been selecting top-three businesses since 2014.

Trained analysts apply a 50-point inspection that includes reputation, history, complaints, ratings, proximity, satisfaction, trust, cost, reviews and excellence. Only businesses that are verified by the team are shown.

The app covers more than 200 cities in 8 countries: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, India, Singapore, Germany and France. More than 500,000 verified businesses are listed.

The Google Play listing says the app is available in English, German, French and Hindi. The App Store listing currently shows English.

On Android, open ThreeBestRated on Google Play and tap Install. On iPhone or iPad, open ThreeBestRated on the App Store and tap Get. The iPhone app needs iOS 15.0 or later.

On Google Play, the developer states that no data is shared with third parties, that the app may collect app info and performance data, and that you can request deletion of your data. On the App Store, the developer states that no data is collected. Read the full privacy policy on the ThreeBestRated website for details.

ThreeBestRated states that every listed business is handpicked by trained analysts after inspection, and that the service operates with full transparency and in compliance with advertising laws.
